title: German Norweigan Seed Tagine Chicken
description: A flavorful and hearty chicken dish combining German and Norwegian influences. The mildly peppery flavor of the seeds pairs perfectly with the rich taste of the tagine sauce.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper.
In a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pot, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken breast until browned on both sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the chicken from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the pot and sauté until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the German seed mustard, Norwegian tagine spice blend, and chicken broth to the pot.
Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Return the chicken breast to the pot and cover with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and braise for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the heavy cream, if using.
Serve the chicken with the tagine sauce spooned over the top and garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
